device.model: UDS services and NRC codes (all standard)
device.name: ISO 14229 UDS (Unified Diagnostic Services) Reference
device.notes:
ISO 14229 UDS is the application layer that sits above ISO-TP on CAN,
KWP2000 on K-line, or DoIP on Ethernet. Every manufacturer-specific
function in this repo — service reset, adaptations, coding, bleeding —
is either UDS or a vendor dialect shaped by it.

This is a REFERENCE spec, not a device. Vehicle specs reference these
service IDs and NRC codes rather than re-inventing them.

Convention: positive response = request service + 0x40 (0x22 → 0x62).
Negative response = 0x7F + service + NRC. Every vehicle spec uses this,
so a negative response to a read is '7F 22 XX' where XX is the NRC.

negative_response_codes.name: Service not supported

negative_response_codes.meaning: Wrong number of bytes or framing error
negative_response_codes.name: Incorrect message length or invalid format

negative_response_codes.name: Response too long

negative_response_codes.meaning: ECU is temporarily unavailable for this request. Try again.
negative_response_codes.name: Busy — repeat request

negative_response_codes.meaning: Prerequisites not met — e.g., engine running when it needs to be off
negative_response_codes.name: Conditions not correct

negative_response_codes.name: No response from subnet component

negative_response_codes.name: Failure prevents execution of requested action

negative_response_codes.name: Request out of range

negative_response_codes.name: Security access denied

negative_response_codes.meaning: The key sent in SecurityAccess was wrong
negative_response_codes.name: Invalid key

negative_response_codes.meaning: Too many wrong keys — delay enforced before next attempt
negative_response_codes.name: Exceeded number of attempts

negative_response_codes.name: Upload/download not accepted

uds_services.description: Switch the ECU between diagnostic sessions
uds_services.name: DiagnosticSessionControl
uds_services.typical_use: First command sent to any ECU. Extended session (0x03) unlocks non-default services.

uds_services.caution: Hard reset (0x01) loses volatile data. Do not use as a keepalive.
uds_services.description: Hard reset of the ECU
uds_services.name: ECUReset

uds_services.description: Challenge-response authentication. Seed/key exchange gated by security level.
uds_services.name: SecurityAccess
uds_services.note: Negative response 7F 27 35 = invalid key. 7F 27 36 = too many attempts (delay enforced).

sub_functions.01: Request seed (odd = request, even+1 = send key)

uds_services.typical_use: Before writing, coding, or running a critical routine. Seed/key algorithm is per-ECU and manufacturer.

uds_services.description: Suppress or re-enable specific message types on the bus
uds_services.name: CommunicationControl
uds_services.note: Used for flashing to stop normal bus traffic from colliding with programming messages.

uds_services.description: Keepalive — tells the ECU the tester is still here
uds_services.name: TesterPresent
uds_services.note: Suppress response byte 0x80 = no response needed (reduces bus load).
uds_services.typical_use: Send every 2-3 seconds after entering a non-default session, or the ECU drops back to default and locks itself. Service 10 01 is not enough — you must stay in the session.

uds_services.description: Adjust timing parameters during a session
uds_services.name: AccessTimingParameter

uds_services.description: Encrypted/authenticated data exchange
uds_services.name: SecuredDataTransmission

uds_services.description: Enable or disable DTC storage
uds_services.name: ControlDTCSetting

uds_services.description: Request the ECU to send a response when a specific event occurs
uds_services.name: ResponseOnEvent

uds_services.description: Control communication baud rate
uds_services.name: LinkControl

uds_services.description: Read a value by its 2-byte DID (Data Identifier). The workhorse of UDS reads.
uds_services.name: ReadDataByIdentifier
uds_services.typical_use: Every read in a vehicle spec — odometer, service distance, VIN, ECU serial

uds_services.description: Read raw memory at a given address and length
uds_services.name: ReadMemoryByAddress
uds_services.note: Length and address width are encoded in the first byte nibbles.

uds_services.description: Read scaling information for a DID
uds_services.name: ReadScalingDataByIdentifier

uds_services.description: Set up periodic transmission of a DID value
uds_services.name: ReadDataByPeriodicIdentifier

uds_services.description: Define a custom DID that maps to one or more existing DIDs
uds_services.name: DynamicallyDefineDataIdentifier

uds_services.description: Write a value to a DID. The write counterpart to service 0x22.
uds_services.name: WriteDataByIdentifier
prerequisites: SecurityAccess (27 XX) — if the DID is locked

uds_services.caution: advanced — can brick the ECU. Know the recovery path.
uds_services.description: Write raw memory — used for flashing
uds_services.name: WriteMemoryByAddress

uds_services.description: Clear DTCs for a diagnostic group
uds_services.name: ClearDiagnosticInformation
uds_services.typical_use: Clear stored DTCs after repair. Record them first.

uds_services.description: Read diagnostic trouble codes with various filters
uds_services.name: ReadDTCInformation

sub_functions.01: Report number of DTCs by status mask

uds_services.caution: advanced — manipulating sensor inputs can cause real-world actuator movement
uds_services.description: Replace an ECU input value or override an output
uds_services.name: InputOutputControlByIdentifier

uds_services.description: Start/stop a named routine in the ECU
uds_services.name: RoutineControl
uds_services.note: A routine ID (RID) is 2 bytes. Example: 31 01 02 FF = start routine 0x02FF.
uds_services.typical_use: ABS bleed, throttle adaptation, service reset (on some ECUs), injector coding

uds_services.description: Prepare ECU for receiving a firmware/data block
uds_services.name: RequestDownload

uds_services.description: Prepare ECU for sending a firmware/data block
uds_services.name: RequestUpload

uds_services.description: Transfer a block of data
uds_services.name: TransferData

uds_services.description: End the transfer sequence
uds_services.name: RequestTransferExit

uds_services.description: File-based transfer (replacement for 34/36/37 in UDS 2013+)
uds_services.name: RequestFileTransfer
